high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for a movie titled "The Greatest of All Time." The poster features a man in the foreground wearing a yellow jacket over a dark shirt. He has a serious expression and is striking a dynamic pose with one arm extended forward. The background appears to be an indoor setting, possibly a pool or a large water tank, as there is water visible behind him. The text on the poster is prominently displayed at the top in bold yellow letters: "FINAL WORLDWIDE BOX OFFICE COLLECTION." Below that, in large red numbers, it states "1500 CRORE," indicating the movie's box office
